summary: Payette NF tower built 1935 on Cold Mountain, moved in 1994 to private land at Payette Lake near McCall, Idaho; only its top 20 feet were restored.

facts.design: 72-foot Aermotor tower with 7x7 metal cab (MC-39 type cab per Keeping Watch)
facts.status_note: Only the top 20 feet of the original 72-foot tower were restored at Payette Lake.

access.note: On private property at Payette Lake, owned by Richard Holm, Jr. Do not visit without the owner's permission.

facts.agency: Richard Holm, Jr. (administers the tower, per NHLR)

events.note: Privy built in 1934 at the original site (HABS); Idaho Fire Lookouts and Keeping Watch give 1934 for the lookout
Tower built in 1935 at the original Cold Mountain site, Payette National Forest, Krassel District
Log cabin built 1936-37 (HABS); NHLR says a cabin was constructed in 1936
NHLR says a young Norman Borlaug staffed the tower the year after the cabin was built
Known staff Leonard Rowland, per Idaho Fire Lookouts
Tower disassembled and removed from the Cold Mountain site under a contract commencing August 1, 1994 (HABS); moved to private property near McCall (Idaho Fire Lookouts)
HABS documentation (dated 1996) recorded the privy and log cabin as extant at the original site
Log cabin burned by a wildfire in 2000, per NHLR
A private party restored the top 20 feet of the tower near the shore of Payette Lake, per NHLR
Keeping Watch dates removal and acquisition by a private party to 2008 (NHLR says restoration in 2007)
Registered January 2, 2008 as US 714, ID 47; nominated by Richard Holm, Jr. and Lawrence Kingsbury

notes_for_editor: Build year conflict: HABS gives privy 1934, tower 1935, cabin 1936-37; NHLR gives 1935; Idaho Fire Lookouts and Keeping Watch give 1934. The story says so. Restoration vs acquisition: NHLR says a private party restored the top 20 feet in 2007; Keeping Watch says removed and acquired by a private party in 2008. Both are reported, not reconciled. Borlaug's Nobel year: NHLR says 1974. From memory, his Nobel Peace Prize was 1970. That is not supported by a fetched source here, so the story omits the year. A human should check the register's wording before it is reused. The HABS report is dated April 1996 (its cabin-extant finding predates NHLR's 2000 burn date; not a true conflict). Record 'ownership' is 'unknown'; NHLR names Richard Holm, Jr. as owner, which could be a correction, but it is a gap rather than an error, so not proposed. The record's coordinates and elevation (1556 m) are for the current Payette Lake site, not the original Cold Mountain site (about 8,084 ft per HABS). A separate record us-id-cold-mountain exists for the original site, which FFLA lists as Gone; the two may need linking. Access level 'private' comes from NHLR owner and Keeping Watch's 'home of a private party'. No photos added; NHLR photo in the record is all rights reserved.
